author: minimax-m2.5
brief: Phase: bug fix. Role: developer. Repo kind: a Python 3.12 invoicing library (standard library only, decimal module) with line items, tax rules, discounts, currencies with different minor units, a formatter, tests, CI config and docs. About 25 files. Inspiration (a bug class only, nothing copied): public localisation libraries have repeatedly fixed defects in currency rounding (banker's rounding versus half up, rounding per line versus on the total, currencies with zero or three decimals). Build a task where the owner reports symptoms (totals off by a cent on some invoices, yen invoices shown with decimals, a discount that makes a total negative), with no diagnosis. Two or three interacting defects, one subtle. Visible tests pass today and do not point at them.
